devices.title: Celestica SD6200 datasheet statements
facts: model_heading_as_printed
SD6200 — 4U 90 HDD Dense Storage SAS-4 Expansion System [PDF p. 1]
power_description
Up to 90 12G SAS or 6G SATA 3.5-inch or 2.5-inch drives; 13 W maximum drive power at 35 C. [PDF p. 1]
esm_configuration_as_printed
Dual redundant hot-swappable ESMs; single ESM configuration supported; ESM = Expansion SAS Module. [PDF p. 1]
esm_interfaces_as_printed
Four 24G SAS4-capable mini-SAS HD ports per ESM; one RJ45 management port; one UART via 3.5 mm jack. [PDF p. 1]
power_description
1300W 80 plus Platinum PSU, 2+2 (200-240V) or 3+1 (100-240V) redundant, hot swap. [PDF p. 2]
power_description
100-127,200-240V AC input, auto ranging, 47~63Hz. These are printed separated voltage bands, not silently a continuous 100-240 V range. [PDF p. 2]
cooling_description
5 x 80 mm dual-rotor fans, hot-pluggable from the top. [PDF p. 2]
physical_description
Height 175.3 mm (6.9 in), width 448 mm (17.64 in), depth 1070 mm (42.12 in) w/CMA. [PDF p. 2]
physical_description
Operating 5 C to 35 C; non-operating -40 C to 60 C; humidity 8% to 80% RH; altitude 0 to 950 m, de-rate temperature 1 C per 300 m above 950 m. [PDF p. 2]
cooling_description
At (23+/-2 C), sound power <7.6 Bel; do not re-label as sound pressure or listening-position noise. [PDF p. 2]
document_revision_and_conflict
Copyright Celestica Inc. 2024; literal token 091024. Footer calls DS6200 a trademark although both headings say SD6200; no alias inferred. [PDF p. 2]

devices.title: Edge-Core Wedge 100-32X datasheet statements
facts: power_description
2 redundant, load-sharing, hot-swappable AC or -54 VDC PSUs; input voltage 120 to 240 VAC at 50-60 Hz and 40 to 72 VDC, as separately printed. [PDF p. 2]
power_description
Separate power input option: 12 VDC; not merged into the -54 VDC PSU line or assumed wired the same way. [PDF p. 2]
power_description
Typical power consumption 436 W, document statement with no test/load condition supplied in this section; not PSU output or maximum draw. [PDF p. 2]
physical_description
Dimensions W x D x H: 44 x 50.7 x 4.4 cm (17.32 x 19.97 x 1.732 in); weight 8.8 kg (19.56 lb). [PDF p. 2]
cooling_description
4+1 redundant, hot-swappable fans; front (port) to back (power) airflow direction. [PDF p. 2]
physical_description
Operating temperature 0 C to 45 C; storage -40 C to 70 C; operating/storage humidity 10% to 90% non-condensing. [PDF p. 2]
software_installation_description

Historical EC-DS-0617-04 document statement (©2016 footer; publication date not independently verified): Switch is loaded with OpenBMC and Diagnostics. Listed compatibility: FBOSS Agent, Open Network Linux, SnapRoute FlexSwitch, Cumulus Linux 3.4 and later. Historical vendor statements, not current support or installed software on an auction unit. [PDF p. 2–3]
